# Zanove Technologies

> Zanove Technologies is a Nigeria-first digital studio helping businesses improve their digital presence and build useful products and connected systems.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://zanovetech.vercel.app/): Digital products, websites and business systems.
- [Services](https://zanovetech.vercel.app/service.html): Website design, software, digital products, AI creative, automation and growth.
- [Website design and development](https://zanovetech.vercel.app/services/website-agency-in-nigeria): Looking for a website agency in Nigeria? Zanove designs and builds mobile-ready business websites for Nigerian SMEs and growing companies.
- [Software and digital product development](https://zanovetech.vercel.app/services/software-and-digital-products): Plan and build custom software, customer portals and digital products around your users and business operations with Zanove Technologies.
- [AI video, image and digital creative](https://zanovetech.vercel.app/services/ai-video-and-creative): Create AI-assisted videos, images and digital campaign assets with a clear brief, consistent brand direction and human review from Zanove.
- [Workflow and AI automation](https://zanovetech.vercel.app/services/workflow-automation): Map repetitive business processes and connect practical workflow or AI automation with clear human checkpoints using Zanove Technologies.
- [SEO, content and audience growth](https://zanovetech.vercel.app/services/seo-and-content-growth): Build search foundations and useful content around your services, customers and business goals with Zanove Technologies.
- [About Zanove](https://zanovetech.vercel.app/about.html): Zanove Technologies and its approach.
- [Projects](https://zanovetech.vercel.app/projects.html): Founder-built product, web, AI and creative work.
- [Website audit](https://zanovetech.vercel.app/audit.html): First-pass public website review and project contact path.
- [Request a consultation](https://zanovetech.vercel.app/project.html): Discuss a website, product, software or workflow.
- [Blog](https://zanovetech.vercel.app/blog): Practical writing on websites, AI and digital growth.
- [Books](https://zanovetech.vercel.app/ebook.html): Books by Vera, with links to their Selar listings.
- [Ask Zanove AI](https://zanovetech.vercel.app/ask-ai.html): AI assistant for questions about Zanove's services and work.
- [Privacy & analytics](https://zanovetech.vercel.app/privacy.html): Analytics choices and information submitted to Zanove.

## Founder-built projects
- [Zanvera Guest Hub](https://zanvera.vercel.app/): QR-led AI guest assistant for independent hotels and rental hosts.
- [No Wahala](https://no-wahala.vercel.app/): Statement-based personal finance dashboard for understanding income, spending and repeat payments.
- [LegacyMag](https://v0-birthday-booklet-landing-page.vercel.app/): Premium milestone and memorial booklet service.
- [DataWise](https://datawise-three.vercel.app/): Nigerian data bundle comparison and personal tracking experience.
- [GlobalPerks](https://dark-rosy.vercel.app/): Visual storytelling portfolio and gallery experience.
